nodes.title: Ask a local server
nodes.help: One call to an OpenAI-compatible server you run (its memory is reserved on the host). pipelines_service makes the call when the dispatcher releases the run.

params.name: model
params.label: Model
params.help: The model name the server takes; empty = the provider's default.

params.name: prompt
params.label: Prompt
params.help: The filled template (pipelines writes it). Not scanned for mentions.

params.name: schema
params.label: Answer schema
params.help: A JSON schema the answer must match (response_format json_schema); empty = plain text.

params.name: tools
params.label: Tools
params.help: OpenAI tool definitions as a JSON array; empty = none. With tools the answer may be tool calls.

nodes.title: Answer
nodes.help: Stores its text as the run's answer: no take. Ask workflows end with it.
